newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya's Moi sacks environment minister.
newsitem.headline: Kenya's Moi sacks environment minister.

text.p: Kenyan President Daniel arap Moi has sacked Environment Minister John Sambu and swapped the country's ministers for energy and tourism.
A statement from the presidency issued on Tuesday said Sambu was replaced by Henry Kosgei. Both come from the Rift Valley region.

Moi moved Tourism and Wildlife Minister Noah Katana Ngala to the ministry of energy. Darius Mbela, the energy ministry, goes to tourism. The statement said the changes were effective immediately. No reasons were given for the minor reshuffle.
